set.body:
Phase A (P0 correctness hotfix). The review rated this P2; it is P0 because it manufactures a FALSE DEFINITE "never submitted".

Problem 1 — unbounded substring match. ssh/SshAgentWireClient.scala:128-150:

    else if exitCode == 126 || exitCode == 127 || normalized.contains("not found") then
      AgentCall.Failed(AgentFailure.AgentUnavailable(...))

The third disjunct is unrestricted by exit code and matches against up to maximumCaptureBytes of remote stderr. Concrete path: ssh exits 255 (connection dropped AFTER the request frame was written) while the remote login shell printed "module: command not found". Classification becomes AgentUnavailable, writeCompleted is discarded, and ssh/Slurm.scala:65-66 reports SubmissionAttempt.InvocationFailed — a definite "never submitted" for a job that may well be queued. This is precisely what the submit path's TransportDisconnected(true, ...) rescue exists to prevent.

Problem 2 — CORRECTION TO THE REVIEW. The review claimed the write flag is misnamed as implying remote receipt. That is REFUTED: requestWriteCompleted (ssh/SshProcessRunner.scala:35), writeCompleted (:83), and afterRequestWrite (protocol/AgentProtocol.scala:148) all honestly say "write", the write is genuinely local (:165), and no doc claims remote receipt. Rename nothing.

The real defect is narrower and worse: only TransportDisconnected carries the flag. AgentUnavailable, AuthenticationFailed, RemoteCliFailure, RemoteAgentFailure, ProtocolViolation and ProtocolMismatch have no such field (AgentProtocol.scala:145-155), so classifying into any of them silently destroys a writeCompleted = true.

Fix:
- Restrict agent-unavailable to exit 126/127 plus narrowly enumerated known diagnostics.
- Carry the write flag on every AgentFailure variant reachable post-write.

Acceptance:
- Test: exit 255, stderr containing "module: command not found", writeCompleted = true => acceptance-unknown, NOT "never submitted". RED against parent. Existing SshFailureClassificationSuite.scala:18-22 covers only the well-behaved exit-127 case.
set.title: P8.A4: Restrict agent-unavailable classification and preserve the write flag
